title: Advanced client mods
description:
A mod pack meant to make the game more enjoyable. 
This modpack aims to help with performance and neat features that makes the game better.
body:
# 🛠️ Performance Optimization
This client-side modpack focuses on making Minecraft smoother, faster, and more stable — all without changing core gameplay.

Increased FPS and reduced lag

Faster world loading and improved chunk rendering

Lower memory usage and better CPU performance

Optimizations for both low-end and high-end systems
Perfect for players who want a cleaner, more responsive experience across all types of gameplay.

## 🎮 Quality of Life Improvements
Enhance your experience with thoughtful, non-intrusive features that make Minecraft more intuitive and enjoyable — while staying 100% compatible with vanilla servers.

Enhanced F3/debug screen with more useful information

Customizable keybinds and hotkeys

Subtle tweaks that improve gameplay flow

Zoom functionality, better frame control, and other handy utilities

### 🔊 Visual & Audio Enhancements
Upgrade the look and sound of Minecraft without altering its core style. These mods add polish and atmosphere without affecting performance or server compatibility.

Support for shaders (Iris) and improved lighting (optional)

Entity culling and dynamic FPS for smoother visuals

Cleaner UI and improved readability

Enhanced ambient audio and sound effects for a more immersive world
